value: Phase 2.B internal runtime coherence, one narrow live governance proof, bounded post-Phase 2.B publicization/readiness, second-window provider-stability hardening, and matured-kernel criteria are closed. Any next work must start with a fresh GC-018/work order. Valid next candidates are hosted/product readiness proof, a longer-horizon provider stability proof, persistence/database implementation only if a real product demand appears, or Maika child-data/photo/vision proof only if an operator demand and privacy design exist. Kernel-owner replacement remains deferred until one-surface freeze-release conditions are met. Matured-kernel criteria may be cited for future screening but do not release any surface. Global freeze lift remains rejected under the binding freeze-release rule.
